# AntV

> AntV 是蚂蚁集团全新一代数据可视化解决方案，提供简单方便、专业可靠、无限可能的数据可视化最佳实践。

Use the Markdown links below for machine-readable content; canonical page links are the authoritative human-facing URLs.

## Agent resources

- [Full documentation](https://antv.antgroup.com/llms-full.txt): Combined Markdown content for all published documents.
- [Canonical site](https://antv.antgroup.com/zh/)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/antvis/antvis.github.io)
- Languages: zh, en
